# Vendored dependencies

- `stb_image.h`: nothings/stb commit `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`; dual MIT / public domain notice included in the file. Only JPEG, PNG, BMP decoding enabled.
- `XPowersLib/`: copied unmodified from waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-PhotoPainter commit `a5e8f757ba0cafbb5586f07d3e83bda3184c0845`, `01_Example/xiaozhi-esp32/components/pmicpower/src`; Lewis He MIT notices retained.
- `Waveshare-MIT.txt`: upstream example project MIT license. Board pins and the display sequence in `main/hardware.cpp` derive from this snapshot.
- `NotoSansSC-OFL.txt`: SIL Open Font License for the raster subset in `components/frame/font_data.h`. Source: google/fonts `ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC[wght].ttf`, retrieved 2026-09-16. Bitmap generation tool is included; no proprietary system fonts shipped.
